note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-26): 16 pictures from 32 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured, and Abram, Sarai, Lot and Pharaoh are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small in the land. The call is a man at a farm gate looking up a road into the mist; the great nation is one house on a hill above a valley of lights; the blessing for every family is one spring feeding many farms; the promise of the land and the altars are shown by the stone altar and by a man kneeling at his tent between two towns. Sarai being taken into Pharaoh's house is shown only by the husband alone outside tall gates, and the plagues by a great house under a storm sky with its doors shut, never by people harmed. Genesis 11 ends with the road to Haran, so this chapter starts from home with a road again; the chapter before has no oak, altar or Egypt.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Yahweh calls Abram to leave everything he knows for a land he will be shown, and promises a great nation, a blessing, and blessing for every family of the ground.
ideas: A man at the gate of a farm courtyard with a packed rucksack, a road winding up into misty hills ahead
From inside a plain house, an open front door frames a long road climbing into far misty hills
One huge old tree on a hilltop with a vast forest grown from its seeds beyond
At blue dusk, one house on a hill with a single lit window and a valley of lit towns beyond
A clear spring at a hilltop sending channels of water to many different farms below
Warm rain falling on a patchwork of many different farms, gardens and orchards
A hand opening to let a bird fly
A map-less compass in an open palm
A great river fed by one small spring seen from the sky
A lantern held up on a hill road at night

sections.meaning: Abram goes as Yahweh told him, with Sarai, Lot and all their household, and passes through Canaan to the great oak at Shechem, in a land where others already live.
ideas: An older gray-haired man and a younger man climbing a country road side by side with packs
An old man's weathered hand tightening a pack strap
A long caravan of people with bundles, pack donkeys and goats crossing a wide green valley
A flock of sheep and goats with pack donkeys on a hill road, a few walkers beside them
A huge old oak on a hillside above a valley of other people's farms, a lone traveler beneath it
A road through a valley of busy farmsteads, a lone traveler passing among watching farmers
Two sets of tracks on a road, one old one new
A fork in a road at a village well
A tent being loaded onto a donkey
A traveler's walking stick leaning on an oak trunk

sections.meaning: Yahweh promises this land to Abram's offspring; Abram builds altars, pitches his tent between Bethel and Ai, calls on Yahweh's name, and keeps moving south toward the Negev.
ideas: A small altar of stacked rough fieldstones on a hilltop with a wide green land beyond, bright morning
A hand laying the last fieldstone on a small stone altar above a wide land
A small canvas tent on a high hill with a town far off on either side and a pile of stones beside it
A man kneeling by a small tent on a hilltop between two distant towns
A long thin line of travelers and pack animals walking south over golden scrubland toward pale desert hills
A dry track winding into pale desert hills under a huge sky
A tent pole being driven into the earth
A campfire cold at dawn beside a tent
A ridge road with two far towns glowing
A single stone cairn on a ridge

sections.meaning: Famine drives Abram down to Egypt; at the border he fears for his life and asks Sarai to say she is his sister.
ideas: A field of withered brown grain with cracked earth under a hard pale sky and a dry stone well
A dry cracked riverbed with a single wilted green shoot
A man and a woman close together on a rise at the edge of the desert, looking down on a lush river valley, he speaking low
A couple talking quietly on a stone bridge entering a city across a wide river
Empty grain sacks hanging on a fence
A thin cow in a bare yard
A border road at dusk with a lit gate far off
A man's hand cupped over a woman's hand
A lush green valley seen from a bare brown hill
A child's empty bowl on a table

sections.meaning: Sarai is taken into Pharaoh's house, and Abram prospers because of her with flocks, cattle, donkeys and camels.
ideas: A man alone outside tall closed iron gates of a grand estate at dusk, a lit house far up the drive
A man's hand gripping the cold bars of a tall iron gate, a grand lit house behind
Camels, donkeys, cattle, sheep and goats grazing together in a lush green river pasture
A row of loaded camels with donkeys and cattle on a desert road
A heavy front door of a great house closing
A table laden with gifts in a hall
A lone man on a bench in a hotel lobby at night
A rich pasture with a herd drinking at a river
A key being handed over
A large black car's taillights going up a long drive

sections.meaning: Yahweh strikes Pharaoh's household with great plagues; Pharaoh confronts Abram, gives Sarai back, and sends them away with everything they have.
ideas: A grand house and courtyard under a heavy dark sky, every door shut, a fountain still
A great banquet hall with a long table of untouched food and all the chairs empty and pushed back
A powerful man behind a big desk pointing sharply across it at a quiet man with bowed head
Two men face to face across a long polished table, one hard-eyed with a raised hand, the other calm with open hands
A man and a woman walking out of a great green river city through a tall open gate with loaded donkeys and a flock, guards watching
Aerial view of a road leaving a green river valley into the desert, a small group with a loaded flock
A hand holding open a heavy door
A suitcase being carried down a grand staircase
Empty hospital corridor at night
A set of keys placed on a desk

scenes.principle: And Yahweh said to Abram, "Go from your land and from your relatives and from your father's house to the land that I will show you.
scenes.shows: A man with a packed rucksack stands at the gate of a farm courtyard, a road winding up into misty hills ahead.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, an ordinary man in plain clothes with a packed rucksack stands at the open gate of a plain farm courtyard with the family home behind him, ahead of him a country road winding up through green hills into far mist, soft overcast morning light. The man and the road are in the upper part of the frame. The subject and every important detail are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
